Previews.dc.html.title: How it looks on X, Facebook, Telegram (approximate)

spec.text:
Share image spec
- 1200 × 630 JPG, under 300 KB; one file per page: og/desklabs.jpg (landing), og/claude.jpg (/claude).
- Safe zone: keep text 64 px from every edge. X crops to about 1.91:1 and Telegram/Facebook can trim a little; nothing important near the edges.
- Key text must stay readable when the card shows at ~500 px wide: headline 64 px+, labels 17 px+.
- No live numbers (they go stale in platform caches): no volume, CPM, PnL or fee rates on the image. The order book and chart are labelled examples, not data.
- After deploy, refresh caches: Facebook Sharing Debugger, X posts pick up the new image within a day, Telegram @WebpageBot.
